scoring.method: Side by side: a crop of the target next to one image per candidate (our builder render, a bench render, the official r187 example screenshot, or the CC0 asset's thumbnail), in docs/gate/scene-quality/sources/<id>.jpg. The score (0-10) is the scene-quality worker's visual judgement of closeness to the target in colour, surface detail, light response and shape, written down with a short reason; not a metric. Our renders are SwiftShader (provisional, L4). Paid candidates are listed and flagged, not downloaded and not scored.
